data.text:
BFP chief Fire Director Jesus Fernandez, nakatakdang sampahan ng reklamong grave misconduct, graft and corruption bukas, March 5, 2026, ayon kay SILG Remulla.

"The big issue is the BFP. Tomorrow, I will file charges against Gen. Fernandez for a clear case of grave misconduct, graft and corruption. I will lay down the predicate of how he stole hundreds of millions from the people, straight to his pocket and straight to his organization," sinabi ni Remulla sa Kapihan sa Manila Bay.

Dagdag pa ni Remulla, nakatakda rin na sampahan ng reklamo ang nasa 50 inidibidwal na sangkot naman sa bid-rigging sa BFP mula noong 2021 hanggang 2025. 

"The day after, we will file cases against another 50 individuals for bid-rigging in the entire BFP spanning from 2021 to 2025. It will show a malicious attempt to create a syndicate to profit from the purchase of fire trucks in the Philippines. 

We’re filing cases against Inspectors who sell fire extinguishers who harassed every single business owner in the country para kumita sila," dagdag ng kalihim.

Courtesy: Kapihan sa Manila Bay
